Robert W. Chambers, The King in Yellow.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/robert-w-chambers/the-king-in-yellow

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Robert W. Chambers, the author, died 1933 (Wikidata Q1349144, P570 = 1933-12-16, 1933-12-13, 1933-01-01).

First publication of the text used: 1895 (SE colophon: 'The King in Yellow was published in 1895 by Robert W. Chambers.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1895, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1990.
- Country of origin: the facts do not establish the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or shorter for these deaths. The last person named above died in 1933, so the text has been public domain in each of them since 1 January 2004.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
